changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 351 البيع عقد يلتزم بمقتضاه البائع بنقل الملكية في مقابل ثمن نقدي
changes.reason: [civil-code 351 ¶1] defines sale as the seller's undertaking to transfer ownership of a thing or property right for a price in money; kept as a required basis. The buyer's duty to pay at delivery is added from [civil-code 388 ¶1].
[civil-code 106 ¶1] says the contract is the law of the parties; the formal-notice module already carries this paragraph, so it is imported.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 164 يجبر المدين بعد إعذاره على التنفيذ العيني متى كان ممكنا
changes.reason: [civil-code 164 ¶1] compels performance in kind after notice under articles 180 and 181; imported with the module's notice step for a payment claim, which only warns.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 323 على الدائن إثبات الالتزام وعلى المدين إثبات التخلص منه
changes.reason: [civil-code 323 ¶1] puts the proof of the obligation on the creditor and of the release on the debtor; imported from the periods module, where it is not marked interpretive.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 179 لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1] makes compensation due only after notice unless a text provides otherwise; imported with the module's notice step for damages.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 186 تعويض الضرر اللاحق من التأخر في الوفاء بمبلغ من النقود
changes.reason: [civil-code 186 ¶1] supports damages for late payment of a sum of money, under conditions the catalogue omits: between individuals, and an amount fixed when the claim is filed; imported from the formal-notice module.

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بأن يؤدي للمدعي باقي ثمن المبيع المقدر بـ (...) دج
changes.reason: Rests on [civil-code 351 ¶1] and [civil-code 388 ¶1]; the line now covers the whole price or its balance.

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بتعويض قدره (...) دج عن التأخر في الدفع
changes.reason: Rests on [civil-code 186 ¶1] after notice under [civil-code 179 ¶1], assessed under [civil-code 182 ¶1].
[cpca 419 ¶1] puts the costs on the losing party unless the judge decides otherwise with reasons.

A written contract is not always required: [civil-code 333 ¶1] requires writing only above the set sum outside commercial matters, [civil-code 334 ¶3] bars witnesses for a balance of a right needing writing, and [civil-code 335 ¶1] admits a beginning of proof in writing; the document is any writing proving the sale and price.
The price falls due on delivery [civil-code 388 ¶1], and delivery is made by putting the thing at the buyer's disposal [civil-code 367 ¶1].

[civil-code 180 ¶1] allows a warning, an equivalent act, the post, or a clause of default at term, and [civil-code 181 ¶1] lists exemptions; the formal-notice module's documents for each case are imported instead of a bailiff's record only.
Elements of the sale under [civil-code 351 ¶1] and [civil-code 59 ¶1]; the form of the contract is added because it governs proof [civil-code 333 ¶1].
[civil-code 364 ¶1] and [civil-code 367 ¶1]; its date matters because the price falls due on delivery [civil-code 388 ¶1].
Split by burden under [civil-code 323 ¶1]: the plaintiff proves the price and its due date, the debtor proves any payment.
[civil-code 179 ¶1] and [civil-code 180 ¶1]; carried by the imported notice steps.

changes.catalogueSays: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1]; the formal-notice module's step for damages, with the exemptions of [civil-code 181 ¶1], is imported. It warns and never blocks.

[civil-code 366 ¶1] time-bars the seller's claim to a price supplement for an excess in quantity one year after actual delivery; counted under [civil-code 314 ¶1], pleaded only [civil-code 321 ¶1]; a limitation, so it warns.
General limitation [civil-code 308 ¶1] from the due date [civil-code 315 ¶1], and the one-year limitation for things supplied by a trader or craftsman to a non-trader [civil-code 312 ¶2].

Means of notice and exemptions [civil-code 180 ¶1] [civil-code 181 ¶1], rescission or performance after notice [civil-code 119 ¶1], delay damages [civil-code 176 ¶1], automatic rescission of a sale of movables [civil-code 392 ¶1], and the module's warnings on notice by another means, by post, after the petition, or without the contract's terms.

Exits to the administrative court [cpca 800 ¶2], the specialised commercial court [cpca 536 مكرر ¶1], the criminal route [civil-code 339 ¶1], and the order to pay for a written fixed debt [cpca 306 ¶1] with its periods [cpca 308 ¶3] [cpca 309 ¶2].

Sections of the court and the civil residual [cpca 32 ¶5], the commercial section [cpca 531 ¶1], national public bodies [cpca 800 ¶2], and the referral of a case listed before the wrong section [cpca 32 ¶6].
Section: civil, commercial when the sale is commercial, civil in a court without sections [cpca 32 ¶5] [cpca 531 ¶1]; interpretive, since no text names the civil section for a civil sale.

Defendant's domicile [cpca 37 ¶1], several defendants [cpca 38 ¶1], commercial options [cpca 39 ¶5], supplies as a reading [cpca 39 ¶4], void jurisdiction clauses, voluntary appearance and the timing of the plea [cpca 45 ¶1] [cpca 46 ¶1] [cpca 47 ¶1].

Sale of real property or business premises: official form and price paid before the officer [civil-code 324 مكرر 1 ¶1], lesion supplement [civil-code 358 ¶1] [civil-code 359 ¶1], publication of the petition [cpca 17 ¶3].
Commercial sale: commercial section [cpca 531 ¶1] and free proof [commercial-code 30 ¶1], against [civil-code 333 ¶1] for civil matters.

Sale of movables with a term for payment and taking delivery is rescinded by law in the seller's favour when unpaid at the term [civil-code 392 ¶1]; choice between performance and rescission [civil-code 119 ¶1].
A loan for consumption [civil-code 450 ¶1] is not a sale [civil-code 351 ¶1].
Buyer's defences: withholding the price on disturbance [civil-code 388 ¶2], non-performance plea [civil-code 123 ¶1], seller's right to keep the thing [civil-code 390 ¶1].
Payments are the debtor's to prove [civil-code 323 ¶1]; separated from the unpaid balance (e3).

Proof of the sale and of the balance: writing above the set sum [civil-code 333 ¶1], no witnesses for a balance of a right needing writing [civil-code 334 ¶3], beginning of proof [civil-code 335 ¶1], impediment or loss [civil-code 336 ¶2].
Provisional execution on request where the judgment rests on an official deed or an acknowledged promise [cpca 323 ¶2], or in urgency [cpca 323 ¶3].
Good-faith performance [civil-code 107 ¶1]; contents of the petition [cpca 15 ¶6] and standing [cpca 13 ¶1].
